# package iec101

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101"
```

Package iec101 holds what the controlling and the controlled station of IEC 60870-5-101 share: the system parameters, the link [State](#type-state) and the sentinel errors.

IEC 60870-5-101 carries the telecontrol ASDUs of package asdu in FT 1.2 frames (package ft12) over a serial line, with the link procedures of IEC 60870-5-2 (package link):

  - unbalanced transmission: the controlling station is the primary station and polls the controlled station for class 1 data (events, confirmations) and class 2 data (cyclic data); see ModeUnbalanced
  - balanced transmission: each station initiates its own messages over a full-duplex point-to-point line; see ModeBalanced

Applications import [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/client) and [github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec101/server). The transport is any io.ReadWriter: a serial port (for example github.com/otfabric/go-serial), a TCP connection to a terminal server that carries the serial byte stream unchanged, or an in-memory pipe for tests. IEC 60870-5-101 over such a TCP stream is still IEC 60870-5-101 (FT 1.2 framing and link procedures), not IEC 60870-5-104.

## Variables

```go
var (
	// ErrClosed reports an operation on a closed client or server.
	ErrClosed = errors.New("iec101: closed")
	// ErrLinkDown reports an operation while the link is not initialized
	// (not yet, or no longer after the peer stopped answering).
	ErrLinkDown = errors.New("iec101: link not initialized")
	// ErrInvalidConfig reports a configuration a client or server cannot
	// be built with.
	ErrInvalidConfig = errors.New("iec101: invalid configuration")
)
```

Sentinel errors shared by the client and the server; test with errors.Is.

## Types

### type Mode

```go
type Mode uint8
```

Mode is the link transmission mode.

```go
const (
	// ModeUnbalanced: the controlling station polls (IEC 60870-5-2 clause 5).
	ModeUnbalanced Mode = iota
	// ModeBalanced: both stations initiate messages (IEC 60870-5-2
	// clause 6). Requires a full-duplex point-to-point line.
	ModeBalanced
)
```

Transmission modes.

#### func (Mode) String

```go
func (m Mode) String() string
```

String returns "unbalanced" or "balanced".

### type Params

```go
type Params struct {
	// Mode is unbalanced or balanced transmission.
	Mode Mode
	// Link holds the link address size and the link timing.
	Link link.Config
	// ASDU holds the ASDU field sizes. A zero MaxSize is set to the largest
	// ASDU one frame carries.
	ASDU asdu.Params
}
```

Params are the IEC 60870-5-101 system parameters both stations must agree on.

#### func DefaultParams

```go
func DefaultParams() Params
```

DefaultParams returns a common profile: unbalanced, 1-octet link address, 1-octet cause of transmission, 1-octet common address and 2-octet information object address (IEC 60870-5-101 8, the interoperability list leaves each choice to the system).

#### func (Params) Normalize

```go
func (p Params) Normalize() (Params, error)
```

Normalize validates p and fills in defaults.

### type State

```go
type State uint8
```

State is the state of the link as seen by one station.

```go
const (
	// StateDown: the link is not initialized.
	StateDown State = iota
	// StateUp: the link is initialized and user data flows.
	StateUp
	// StateClosed: the station was closed.
	StateClosed
)
```

Link states.

#### func (State) String

```go
func (s State) String() string
```

String returns "down", "up" or "closed".
